frameworks.name: LangGraph
frameworks.strengths: Graph-based state machines, fine-grained control over agent flow, strong persistence and human-in-the-loop support
frameworks.bestFor: Complex multi-step workflows where you need explicit control over state and branching

frameworks.name: CrewAI
frameworks.strengths: Role-based multi-agent teams, fast to prototype, gentle learning curve
frameworks.bestFor: Multi-agent collaboration patterns (crew of specialists) without deep framework code

frameworks.name: OpenAI Agents SDK
frameworks.strengths: Lightweight primitives (agents, handoffs, guardrails), first-class OpenAI model integration
frameworks.bestFor: Teams standardized on OpenAI models who want a minimal, official abstraction

frameworks.name: Claude Agent SDK
frameworks.strengths: Full coding-agent harness (file tools, bash, subagents, hooks, MCP), batteries included
frameworks.bestFor: Agents that operate on code and filesystems; Claude-native workflows

frameworks.name: AutoGen
frameworks.strengths: Conversation-driven multi-agent patterns, research heritage, event-driven architecture in v0.4
frameworks.bestFor: Research and experimentation with conversational multi-agent topologies
